mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high retail sales (RSAFS above 380,000 million dollars), a monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: The combination of RSAFS > 380,000 and HOUST rise > 0.5% in the prior month fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production (INDPRO > 110), a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: The combination of INDPRO > 110 and a decline > 0.5% in the prior month fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals conflicting economic signals: weak manufacturing and strong housing, which typically indicates a shift in economic activity that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline > 0.5% and HOUST rise > 0.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A compound signal of high retail sales (RSAFS > 385,000 million dollars) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1,000 thousand units) signals a weak consumer spending environment with a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak consumer spending and housing market
failure_condition: The combination of RSAFS > 385000 and HOUST < 1000 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
